title: An operation whose source account was merged earlier in the ledger fails opNO_ACCOUNT
pattern: Core applies a ledger's classic phase before its Soroban phase and re-checks the source account, sequence number, signatures and sequence-age preconditions at apply (TransactionFrame::commonValid; OperationFrame::checkSignature with forApply). Here a classic transaction earlier in the same ledger merges this transaction's operation source account away, so the transaction fails with txFAILED and the operation result opNO_ACCOUNT.

hazards.placement: OperationResult.opNO_ACCOUNT in a closed ledger: operation source merged earlier in the ledger

facts.says: The transaction fails with tx_failed / op_no_account although it was valid when submitted.
The transaction that caused it is in the same ledger.
The sequence number is consumed: the source account changes before apply.
No operation was applied: the operation meta is empty.
The operation source is the account changed earlier in the ledger.
The unused resource fee is refunded after apply (two changes on the fee source).
